how: We read the website of every Washington DC wedding videographer listed on Lazo (129 listings, 99 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: corporate and brand video agencies, a general production house, a venue and a DJ company listed as videographers, and photo-only studios. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Is audio from the vows and toasts recorded on lapel mics and a board feed, or just the camera?
Have you filmed inside a historic DC venue or church with lighting and movement restrictions, and how did you handle it?
How long until the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files included?

picks.name: Catch Motion Studio
picks.blurb: Since 2013, Catch Motion Studio has filmed and photographed more than 1,200 luxury South Asian weddings, and its cinematography is built around the rituals and candid emotions of Indian celebrations. Ashburn-based, serving couples nationwide.

picks.name: Theogenic Photography & Videography
picks.blurb: A photography and videography team for weddings in the DMV that prefers truthful work: no dramatic modification, just leading your eye to the essence of the moment. Theogenic also covers pre-wedding, engagement and family sessions from McLean.

picks.name: The FilmKraft Production
picks.blurb: A small team of filmmakers and photographers based in Maryland who call themselves hopeless romantics and say they direct your love story rather than just record it. Luxury photo and cinematic film across the DMV, the East Coast and destinations worldwide.

picks.name: Photographick Studios
picks.blurb: The cinematography side of Photographick Studios covers multi-day Hindu, Sikh and interfaith weddings with the same team that shoots the photos. DC-area based, widely published, and set up for tailored service from pre-wedding logistics meetings onward.

picks.name: Whole Heart Studios
picks.blurb: Billy and Taylor are the lead videographers and photographers at Whole Heart Studios, two best friends who describe themselves as adventurous, fearless and in love with love stories. Arlington-based, covering Virginia, North Carolina, DC and Maryland.

picks.name: Arazo Studios Photography & Videography
picks.blurb: Arazo Studios is a team of photographers and videographers that has captured hundreds of weddings across Virginia, Maryland, DC and beyond, and says you can mix and match any options or packages. Chantilly-based, with the same style and mission across the whole crew.

picks.name: Fine Art Wedding Film
picks.blurb: A Frederick team making multiday, Jewish and Indian wedding films with clear pricing published on the site. Full-day coverage is ten consecutive hours and the feature film runs 40 to 120 minutes in 4K; the lead says he films every wedding as if it were his first, his last and his most important.

picks.name: Cork and Banner Films
picks.blurb: Shane has filmed hundreds of weddings and keeps the approach simple: know when and where the candid moments happen, and make you feel like yourselves in front of the camera. Cork and Banner makes films for luxury weddings across Maryland, Virginia and DC.

picks.name: Feeling Wedding Films
picks.blurb: A small, family-run studio for videography, photography and live-streaming across DC, Virginia and Maryland. Feeling Wedding Films handles every step itself, from the first email through filming, editing and delivery, rather than passing you between departments.

picks.name: FootPrint Fotos
picks.blurb: FootPrint Fotos began in 1988 with portraits, moved into weddings within three years, was averaging over 25 a year by 1995 and added cinematography in 1998. A boutique still-and-motion firm in Washington that also covers corporate and celebrity events.

picks.name: SVC FILMS
picks.blurb: SVC Films makes cinematic and documentary wedding films across DC, Virginia, Maryland, Baltimore and Richmond, and says plainly that it does not try to be everything to everyone. The films are for couples who value the real moments, the laughter and the quiet ones alike.

picks.name: Samshots Photo and Video
picks.blurb: A team of wedding photographers, videographers and editors based in Washington DC, covering weddings downtown, out in the Virginia countryside and abroad. Samshots shoots engagements and other milestones too, and bills its work as real and true to you.
